status: unadopted; source pins only verified; native class/cut/transport/semantic producers unqualified

nativeClass.classOid: resolve from original target; never constant

selector: complete original namespace name membership with independent namespace OID admission

parameterGrammar.itemDomain: exact original admitted namespace name under protected cut, paired with independently proven original pg_namespace OID
parameterGrammar.encoder: exact original text; no name folding or search_path resolution

coverage: Complete namespace relation membership without expected-name/kind/hint filters; every returned namespace_oid equals independently admitted namespace OID. Empty rows alone cannot prove namespace presence/completeness.
preservation: Retain full exact returned row JSON text and every unknown extension member; lossless bounded selected native JSON decoder; no parse/stringify reconstruction

dependencyExtraction.types: nonzero reltype/reloftype actual pg_type; zero kind-specific native sentinel retained
dependencyExtraction.relations: nonzero reltoastrelid actual pg_class with complete original definition, not ignored storage internals
dependencyExtraction.method: nonzero relam actual pg_am with handler/type/member closure; display name cannot replace identity
dependencyExtraction.tablespace: nonzero reltablespace actual shared pg_tablespace with selected original route/definition; zero default context separately resolved, not fake address
dependencyExtraction.scope: relnamespace local pg_namespace; relowner shared pg_authid; relisshared/native scope requires exact original selected meaning, not automatic address retagging
dependencyExtraction.adjuncts: complete columns/defaults/indexes/constraints/triggers/policies/rewrite/inheritance/partition and sequence configuration where native kind requires; lazy flags never suppress tasks
dependencyExtraction.nativeFacts: ACL/options null/dimensions/order and partition native expression retained; decoded relation_options object is not evidence of exact original native text/array semantics

fieldClassification.oid: Original native relation address, not portable cross-install identity; resolve original namespace/name/kind and owner lineage.
fieldClassification.relname: Exact native name in resolved namespace; implicit generated names require explicit original creator correspondence, not heuristic matching.
fieldClassification.relnamespace: Resolve original namespace and complete membership; same displayed name does not establish namespace custody.
fieldClassification.relkind: PG17 r/i/S/t/v/m/c/f/p/I determines field applicability and required adjuncts; unknown kind unsupported.
fieldClassification.relpersistence: Preserve p/u/t declaration with selected native kind/host durability qualification; never infer durability from p alone.
fieldClassification.relowner: Resolve original shared owner and policy/current authority separately; name alone not authority.
fieldClassification.reltype: Resolve actual row type when present; kind-specific zero retained, not synthesized missing type.
fieldClassification.reloftype: Resolve original typed-table composite type; zero means not typed under admitted grammar.
fieldClassification.relam: Resolve actual method with kind applicability; partitioned-table nonzero controls future default partition method, not parent physical file.
fieldClassification.reltablespace: Resolve nonzero tablespace or original database-default context; partitioned table specifies future partition default, not parent storage.
fieldClassification.reltoastrelid: Resolve complete original TOAST relation/index/attribute/ownership closure; zero explicitly none, no blanket internal-object exclusion.
fieldClassification.relnatts: Exact int2 user slot count with dropped slots retained and system slots separate; require complete original attribute correspondence.
fieldClassification.relchecks: Exact int2 check count reconciled with complete original constraint fanout; count not constraint semantics.
fieldClassification.relhasindex: Lazy historical hint retained; actual full index fanout defines membership, hint never suppresses collection.
fieldClassification.relhasrules: Lazy historical hint retained; actual full rewrite fanout defines membership.
fieldClassification.relhastriggers: Lazy historical hint retained; actual full trigger fanout defines membership.
fieldClassification.relhassubclass: Lazy historical hint retained; complete original inheritance/partition graph defines membership.
fieldClassification.relrowsecurity: Declared RLS enable state with full policy/owner/current role context; table rights alone do not prove row disclosure.
fieldClassification.relforcerowsecurity: Owner-force declaration effective when RLS enabled; retain separately from bypass and actual current authority.
fieldClassification.relispartition: Partition membership fact requires complete original parent/bound context for tables and indexes.
fieldClassification.relpartbound: Retain exact nullable original native tree with type/collation/operator/default-bound closure; display SQL not proof.
fieldClassification.relreplident: PG17 d/n/f/i with complete selected primary/replica index state; missing former index cannot imply live usable identity.
fieldClassification.relispopulated: Original materialized-view usability state; matching definition does not prove data completeness; no automatic refresh.
fieldClassification.relisshared: Original cluster-wide storage scope, not automatic rewriting of local dependency address class.
fieldClassification.relacl: Retain nullable ordered native ACL/dimensions and source default/explicit policy; current rights separate.
fieldClassification.reloptions: Retain ordered nullable native keyword=value options/dimensions, duplicates and unknowns; selected method grammar required.
fieldClassification.relfilenode: Raw original physical identifier; zero can mean mapped relation. Excluded from portable definition only with reason, no file lookup or inferred missing storage.
fieldClassification.relpages: Raw int4 planner page estimate, not exact size or resource budget; retain separately from stable declaration.
fieldClassification.reltuples: Raw original float4 planner estimate including -1 unknown; not exact row count, readiness or JS-number canonical identity.
fieldClassification.relallvisible: Raw int4 visibility-map page estimate, not proof of snapshot visibility or correctness.
fieldClassification.relrewrite: Original rewrite source address; selected user-visible completed catalog expects zero, nonzero refuses readiness rather than silently excluded.
fieldClassification.relfrozenxid: Raw native wraparound/vacuum horizon, kind-qualified invalid zero; no total integer ordering or stable definition equality.
fieldClassification.relminmxid: Raw native multixact horizon, kind-qualified invalid zero; no generic transaction-ID ordering or codec claim.

dependencyExtraction.canonicalProcedure: Admit original native relation identity/kind/scope; collect all original kind-required definitions and complete child fanouts independently of lazy hints; reconcile user slots/check counts and type/owner/method/tablespace/TOAST/hierarchy/native-tree closure. Stable declaration comparison explicitly excludes retained physical estimates/horizons/historical hints with reasons, while readiness independently admits required native state. Unknown kind/option/tree or unavailable kind-specific adjunct refuses completeness. No VACUUM/ANALYZE/refresh/file access/foreign contact/expression evaluation occurs.

adjuncts: relation/column/sequence ACL/effective rights and owner/namespace/RLS authority facts
refusal: Unsupported kind/shared scope/storage/partition/options/native expression or missing required adjunct/definition refuses semantic completeness; no lazy flag, count or display name qualifies installation
resourceObligations: Shared enclosing totals, complete original cut/authority and explicit pre-materialization/native-work permits; no independent per-route allowance
